```python
import openpyxl

INPUT_FILE = "ssb_341_40_init.xlsx"
OUTPUT_FILE = "output.xlsx"
SHEET_NAME = "Sheet1"
MAX_ROW = 701

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_FILE)

if SHEET_NAME in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[SHEET_NAME]
else:
    ws = wb[wb.sheetnames[0]]

def norm(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()

last_row = min(ws.max_row, MAX_ROW)

for r in range(1, last_row + 1):
    a_val = norm(ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value)   # Column A
    b_val = norm(ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value)   # Column B
    c_val = norm(ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value)   # Column C

    if a_val == "government" and b_val == "germany" and c_val == "carretera":
        ws.cell(row=r, column=17).value = "Volkswagen"  # Column Q

wb.save(OUTPUT_FILE)
```
